title: mentha arvensis var. fontana
intro: Mentha arvensis var. fontana, commonly known as American pennyroyal, is a variety of mint plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce menstrual cramps, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha arvensis var. fontana include its use as a carminative, antispasmodic, and antiseptic agent, making it effective in treating a range of symptoms from nausea and gas to skin irritations and infections. Its bioactive constituents include menthone, isomenthone, limonene, and linalool, among other compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential applications in traditional medicine.
